column_rules.nullable: Boolean. False is required for primary-key and tenant-key columns.
column_rules.default_sql: SQL expression string or null when callers must supply a value.
column_rules.identifier: Externally addressable resources use uuid; application-generated UUIDv7 is preferred and gen_random_uuid() is the Supabase PostgreSQL 15-compatible fallback
column_rules.opaque_payload: bytea plus media type and SHA-256 for exact replay or provider envelopes
column_rules.jsonb: Allowed only when the sixth column-tuple element names configuration, external_payload, or audit_context. Money, quantity, rate, tax components, identifiers used as relationships, permissions, and identifier arrays remain relational columns or child tables.

tenant_classes.tenant_direct: Contains org_id and uses PRIMARY KEY (org_id,id). All tenant and actor FKs include org_id.
tenant_classes.tenant_association: Pure non-addressable relationship with an org_id-leading natural composite primary key and no surrogate id. All tenant and actor FKs include org_id.
tenant_classes.tenant_projection: Rebuildable tenant read model with an org_id-leading natural composite primary key and no surrogate id; never owns a source business fact.
tenant_classes.global_identity_root: Single UUID primary key, but visibility is membership-derived and FORCE RLS is mandatory.
tenant_classes.global_reference: Stable controlled-code primary key or UUID when externally addressable; runtime is read-only and writes are controlled migrations only.

global_reference_population_modes.application_seed: Reviewed deterministic rows are required in the baseline before the application can start.
global_reference_population_modes.regulated_import: The baseline creates an empty ledger; only a reviewed importer command may populate official effective-dated releases.

rls_classes.tenant_membership: FORCE RLS; org_id must equal app.org_id and app.membership_id must resolve to an active membership in that organization.
rls_classes.organization_membership: FORCE RLS; organization id must be one of the verified actor's active memberships; bootstrap uses a bounded security-definer transaction.
rls_classes.user_shared_membership: FORCE RLS; self or an authorized actor sharing an active organization may read; mutations require access-management permission.
rls_classes.global_reference_read_only: Runtime SELECT only; no runtime INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE grant.

foreign_key_shape.tenant_rule: A reference from a tenant table to another tenant table must begin with org_id on both sides.
foreign_key_shape.actor_rule: Every membership actor column is paired with local org_id and references core.memberships(org_id,id).

index_shape.rule: Tenant indexes begin with org_id. Do not duplicate the primary key or a unique constraint.

lifecycle_shape.not_applicable: Use null state_column, empty states/terminal/transitions, and null initial.

delete_policy: Regulated and actor-evidence rows are never hard-deleted. Master rows are disabled with lifecycle state. CASCADE is limited to replaceable authorization/composition children.
fact_ownership_rule: Each table names exactly one authoritative fact. Projections, balances, credentials, files, and Supabase Auth identities remain externally or separately owned.
